title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E4 — Card Sharps
Fred is convinced that Lamont's card-playing buddies are trying to sock it to him for every cent he's got, but Lamont won't believe him. Fred's attempts at signaling Lamont create nothing but constant turmoil.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E5 — Whiplash
After Fred has an accident in the pick-up truck, he decides he is suffering from whiplash. Fred's friend Bubba (Don Bexley) convinces him he is sitting on a gold mine. Lamont, on the other hand, is sure his father is faking.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E6 — Have Gun, Will Sell
Lamont and his friend Rollo (Nathaniel Taylor) scare off a burglar in the Sanford house, but he leaves something behind -- a gun. Rollo convinces Fred and Lamont that they could make some money if they pawn the gun, but the scheme explodes.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E7 — The Dowry
Fred's cousin and his new bride visit from St. Louis with the idea of finding a husband for his cousin's new stepdaughter. When Fred learns there's a $10,000 dowry involved, he schemes to get Lamont to ask for her hand in marriage.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E8 — Camp-out, The
George may be over his head when he introduces his young clerk Marcus to 'roughing it.'.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E9 — The Last Leaf
When a superstitious Louise gets a 'sign' that her marriage is doomed, George is forced to make a decision that could change the rest of their lives.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E10 — Louise's New Interest
Is Louise going away on a weekend Indian 'dig' because of her interest in archeology or in the handsome archeologist? And that's exactly what George and Helen want to know.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E11 — Costume Party, The
George's cleaning business may be cleaned up for good when he resorts to playing a dirty trick in order to secure the business of a large costume company.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E12 — Florence Gets Lucky
George must make a painful admission when he discovers he needs Florence far more than he could ever expect.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E13 — George Needs Help
When George stubbornly refuses to hire some badly needed help for his store, Louise and Florence combine forces to make him change his mind.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E14 — The Jefferson Curve
After watching George Jefferson in action, his young protege Marcus bends the truth to win the heart of a young lady and throws a curve that lands Lionel in foul territory.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E7 — Henry 'Hank' Aaron, Lee Grant, Gladys Knight, Andrew Johnson
Lee shoots a commercial; baseball great Hank Aaron does Q&A then is the subject of a testimonial dinner sketch with the full cast.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E9 — Ed McMahon, Charlie Callas, Leonard Nimoy
Callas does a physical comedy routine; McMahon is a huckster and Flip & Nimoy are in the environmentalist Mafia.

description:

Lisa surprises the twins with homemade dresses for their senior prom.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E21 — Shoeless
With the help of her grandfather's horse-drawn carriage and a pair of borrowed shoes from Tia, Tamera stars in a '90s-style Cinderella story.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E22 — Graduation
The twins are graduating from high school, but the future doesn't look as bright for Tia's boyfriend Tyreke, who's having a tough time getting his high school equivalency degree.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E1 — Home Sweet Dorm
Tia and Tamera are off to college but they encounter housing problems during their search for the perfect dorm situation; Ray looks forward to remodeling their room.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E2 — Stop In The Name Of Fun
All work and no play makes Tia a dull girl... until Tamera signs her up for a spot on an MTV talent show!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E3 — Home Court Advantage
At Tamera's urging, Lisa hires a new assistant, Todd Banks, an attractive young male graduate who turns out to be lazy on the job. After a number of screw-ups, Lisa fires him.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E4 — We Are Family
Ray's run for State Senate has his family up in arms after their lives become an open book in the press.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E5 — The Grass Is Always Finer
Tia's crush on a handsome teacher leaves her shaken, stirred, and on the rocks with her boyfriend.

title: Webster
description:

An enthusiastic George takes the family on a fishing trip, but all Webster can think about is the fun he could be having with his buddies.
